// Modified 2026: M3JDK optional collection projection; source contracts preserved.
package jdk.m3.collections;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.Iterator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.NavigableMap;
import java.util.NavigableSet;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Random;
import java.util.TreeMap;
import java.util.TreeSet;
import java.util.function.BiPredicate;
import java.util.function.Predicate;

/** Standalone Java 21 contract oracle; JUnit wrapper delegates to this same entry point. */
public final class M3MutableFilteredViewsContract {
    private static int assertions;
    private static final Predicate<Integer> EVEN = x -> x != null && (x & 1) == 0;
    private static final BiPredicate<Integer, Integer> MAP_FILTER =
            (key, value) -> key != null && (key & 1) == 0 && (value == null || value >= 0);

    private M3MutableFilteredViewsContract() { }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        for (boolean descending : new boolean[] {false, true}) {
            setOracle(descending);
            mapOracle(descending);
        }
        rangeContracts();
        iteratorMutationContracts();
        nullContracts();
        bulkAndNestedViewContracts();
        System.out.println("PASS M3_MUTABLE_FILTERED_VIEWS assertions=" + assertions);
    }

    private static void check(Object expected, Object actual, String context) {
        assertions++;
        if (!Objects.equals(expected, actual)) {
            throw new AssertionError(context + " expected=" + expected + " actual=" + actual);
        }
    }

    private static void fails(Class<? extends Throwable> type, Runnable op, String context) {
        assertions++;
        try { op.run(); }
        catch (Throwable failure) {
            if (type.isInstance(failure)) return;
            throw new AssertionError(context + " unexpected=" + failure, failure);
        }
        throw new AssertionError(context + " expected " + type.getSimpleName());
    }

    private static NavigableSet<Integer> expectedSet(NavigableSet<Integer> source,
            Predicate<? super Integer> filter) {
        TreeSet<Integer> result = new TreeSet<>(source.comparator());
        for (int value : source) if (filter.test(value)) result.add(value);
        return result;
    }

    private static NavigableMap<Integer, Integer> expectedMap(NavigableMap<Integer, Integer> source,
            BiPredicate<? super Integer, ? super Integer> filter) {
        TreeMap<Integer, Integer> result = new TreeMap<>(source.comparator());
        source.forEach((k, v) -> { if (filter.test(k, v)) result.put(k, v); });
        return result;
    }

    private static void compareSet(NavigableSet<Integer> source, NavigableSet<Integer> view,
            String label) {
        NavigableSet<Integer> expected = expectedSet(source, EVEN);
        check(new ArrayList<>(expected), new ArrayList<>(view), label + " iteration");
        check(new ArrayList<>(expected.descendingSet()), new ArrayList<>(view.descendingSet()), label + " descending");
        check(expected.size(), view.size(), label + " size");
        check(expected.isEmpty(), view.isEmpty(), label + " empty");
        check(expected.comparator(), view.comparator(), label + " comparator");
        for (int key = -18; key <= 18; key++) {
            check(expected.contains(key), view.contains(key), label + " contains " + key);
            check(expected.lower(key), view.lower(key), label + " lower " + key);
            check(expected.floor(key), view.floor(key), label + " floor " + key);
            check(expected.ceiling(key), view.ceiling(key), label + " ceiling " + key);
            check(expected.higher(key), view.higher(key), label + " higher " + key);
        }
        if (!expected.isEmpty()) {
            check(expected.first(), view.first(), label + " first");
            check(expected.last(), view.last(), label + " last");
        }
    }

    private static void setOracle(boolean descending) {
        TreeSet<Integer> root = new TreeSet<>();
        NavigableSet<Integer> source = descending ? root.descendingSet() : root;
        NavigableSet<Integer> view = M3MutableFilteredViews.filter(source, EVEN);
        Random random = new Random(descending ? 2389 : 1947);
        for (int step = 0; step < 390; step++) {
            int key = random.nextInt(35) - 17;
            switch (random.nextInt(6)) {
                case 0 -> source.add(key);
                case 1 -> source.remove(key);
                case 2 -> {
                    if (EVEN.test(key)) {
                        boolean expected = !source.contains(key);
                        check(expected, view.add(key), "set add existing oracle");
                    }
                    else fails(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> view.add(key), "set rejects invalid");
                }
                case 3 -> {
                    boolean visible = source.contains(key) && EVEN.test(key);
                    check(visible, view.remove(key), "set remove filtered");
                }
                case 4 -> {
                    TreeSet<Integer> expected = new TreeSet<>(source);
                    expected.removeIf(x -> EVEN.test(x) && x > 5);
                    view.removeIf(x -> x > 5);
                    check(expected, root, "set filtered bulk removal");
                }
                default -> { /* comparison-only step */ }
            }
            compareSet(source, view, "set descending=" + descending + " step=" + step);
        }
    }

    private static void compareMap(NavigableMap<Integer, Integer> source,
            NavigableMap<Integer, Integer> view, String label) {
        NavigableMap<Integer, Integer> expected = expectedMap(source, MAP_FILTER);
        check(expected, view, label + " equals");
        check(new ArrayList<>(expected.entrySet()), new ArrayList<>(view.entrySet()), label + " iteration");
        check(new ArrayList<>(expected.descendingMap().entrySet()),
                new ArrayList<>(view.descendingMap().entrySet()), label + " descending entries");
        check(new ArrayList<>(expected.navigableKeySet()), new ArrayList<>(view.navigableKeySet()), label + " keys");
        check(new ArrayList<>(expected.values()), new ArrayList<>(view.values()), label + " values");
        check(expected.size(), view.size(), label + " size");
        check(expected.isEmpty(), view.isEmpty(), label + " empty");
        check(expected.comparator(), view.comparator(), label + " comparator");
        check(expected.firstEntry(), view.firstEntry(), label + " first entry");
        check(expected.lastEntry(), view.lastEntry(), label + " last entry");
        for (int key = -12; key <= 12; key++) {
            check(expected.containsKey(key), view.containsKey(key), label + " contains " + key);
            check(expected.get(key), view.get(key), label + " get " + key);
            check(expected.lowerEntry(key), view.lowerEntry(key), label + " lower " + key);
            check(expected.floorEntry(key), view.floorEntry(key), label + " floor " + key);
            check(expected.ceilingEntry(key), view.ceilingEntry(key), label + " ceiling " + key);
            check(expected.higherEntry(key), view.higherEntry(key), label + " higher " + key);
        }
    }

    private static void mapOracle(boolean descending) {
        TreeMap<Integer, Integer> root = new TreeMap<>();
        NavigableMap<Integer, Integer> source = descending ? root.descendingMap() : root;
        NavigableMap<Integer, Integer> view = M3MutableFilteredViews.filterEntries(source, MAP_FILTER);
        Random random = new Random(descending ? 3001 : 2701);
        for (int step = 0; step < 430; step++) {
            int key = random.nextInt(23) - 11;
            Integer value = random.nextInt(5) == 0 ? null : random.nextInt(15) - 5;
            switch (random.nextInt(7)) {
                case 0 -> source.put(key, value);
                case 1 -> source.remove(key);
                case 2 -> {
                    if (MAP_FILTER.test(key, value)) {
                        Integer prior = view.get(key);
                        check(prior, view.put(key, value), "map put previous visible");
                    } else {
                        var before = new TreeMap<>(root);
                        fails(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> view.put(key, value), "map invalid put");
                        check(before, root, "map failed put unmodified");
                    }
                }
                case 3 -> {
                    Integer previous = view.get(key);
                    check(previous, view.remove(key), "map remove visible");
                    if (previous != null || !view.containsKey(key)) {
                        // Look at source after removal through the general oracle.
                    }
                }
                case 4 -> {
                    var before = new TreeMap<>(root);
                    view.clear();
                    before.entrySet().removeIf(e -> MAP_FILTER.test(e.getKey(), e.getValue()));
                    check(before, root, "map clear preserves hidden");
                }
                case 5 -> {
                    Map<Integer, Integer> incoming = Map.of(2, 7, 4, 9);
                    view.putAll(incoming);
                }
                default -> { /* comparison-only */ }
            }
            compareMap(source, view, "map descending=" + descending + " step=" + step);
        }
    }

    private static void rangeContracts() {
        NavigableSet<Integer> source = new TreeSet<>();
        for (int i = -15; i <= 15; i++) source.add(i);
        NavigableSet<Integer> view = M3MutableFilteredViews.filter(source, EVEN);
        NavigableSet<Integer> subset = view.subSet(-4, true, 7, false).descendingSet();
        check(List.of(6, 4, 2, 0, -2, -4), new ArrayList<>(subset), "subset descending");
        check(true, subset.remove(4), "subset removal");
        check(false, source.contains(4), "underlying sees subset remove");
        fails(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> subset.add(9), "range rejection");
        fails(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> subset.add(3), "filter rejection");
        subset.clear();
        check(true, source.contains(1), "subset clear preserves hidden odd");
        check(true, source.contains(8), "subset clear preserves outside");
        check(false, source.contains(0), "subset clear removes visible");
        fails(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> view.subSet(8, false, -8, true), "invalid range");

        NavigableMap<Integer, Integer> map = new TreeMap<>();
        for (int i = -12; i <= 12; i++) map.put(i, i % 3 == 0 ? null : i);
        NavigableMap<Integer, Integer> filtered = M3MutableFilteredViews.filterEntries(map, MAP_FILTER);
        NavigableMap<Integer, Integer> range = filtered.subMap(-6, true, 7, false).descendingMap();
        check(List.of(6, 4, 2, 0, -6), new ArrayList<>(range.navigableKeySet()), "map range keys");
        check(2, range.put(2, 8), "map replace visible previous");
        check(8, map.get(2), "map range put backed");
        range.clear();
        check(true, map.containsKey(3), "range clear preserves hidden mapping");
        check(true, map.containsKey(8), "range clear preserves outside mapping");
        check(false, map.containsKey(2), "range clear removes visible mapping");
        fails(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> range.put(10, 4), "map out of range");
        fails(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> filtered.subMap(5, true, -5, true), "map invalid range");
    }

    private static void iteratorMutationContracts() {
        NavigableSet<Integer> source = new TreeSet<>(List.of(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6));
        NavigableSet<Integer> view = M3MutableFilteredViews.filter(source, EVEN);
        Iterator<Integer> cursor = view.iterator();
        fails(IllegalStateException.class, cursor::remove, "set remove before next");
        check(2, cursor.next(), "set first cursor");
        check(true, cursor.hasNext(), "set hasNext prefetch before remove");
        cursor.remove();
        check(false, source.contains(2), "set cursor remove");
        fails(IllegalStateException.class, cursor::remove, "set repeated iterator remove");
        check(4, cursor.next(), "set iteration after remove");
        check(6, view.descendingIterator().next(), "set descending iterator");

        NavigableMap<Integer, Integer> map = new TreeMap<>();
        map.put(2, null); map.put(4, 4); map.put(6, -6); map.put(8, 8);
        NavigableMap<Integer, Integer> filtered = M3MutableFilteredViews.filterEntries(map, MAP_FILTER);
        Iterator<Map.Entry<Integer, Integer>> entries = filtered.entrySet().iterator();
        fails(IllegalStateException.class, entries::remove, "entry remove before next");
        Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> first = entries.next();
        check(2, first.getKey(), "entry null-valued key");
        check(null, first.getValue(), "entry null value");
        check(true, entries.hasNext(), "entry prefetch before remove");
        entries.remove();
        check(false, map.containsKey(2), "entry cursor remove");
        Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> second = entries.next();
        check(4, second.getKey(), "entry key 4");
        check(4, second.setValue(10), "entry.setValue previous");
        check(10, map.get(4), "entry.setValue delegated");
        fails(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> second.setValue(-10), "entry value invalid");
        check(10, map.get(4), "failed entry.setValue unchanged");
        check(List.of(8, 4), new ArrayList<>(filtered.descendingKeySet()), "map descending keys");
        check(true, filtered.values().remove(8), "values remove delegates");
        check(false, map.containsKey(8), "values removal visible backing");
    }

    private static void bulkAndNestedViewContracts() {
        NavigableSet<Integer> root = new TreeSet<>(List.of(1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8));
        NavigableSet<Integer> filtered = M3MutableFilteredViews.filter(root, EVEN);
        fails(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> filtered.addAll(List.of(10, 11, 12)), "set invalid bulk admission");
        check(false, root.contains(10), "set bulk rejected atomically by predicate");
        check(true, filtered.addAll(List.of(10, 12)), "set accepted bulk");
        NavigableSet<Integer> nested = filtered.descendingSet().descendingSet().tailSet(4, true);
        check(List.of(4, 6, 8, 10, 12), new ArrayList<>(nested), "nested live views");
        check(true, nested.retainAll(List.of(8, 12)), "nested retainAll");
        check(true, root.contains(2), "nested mutation preserves outside");
        check(true, root.contains(3), "nested mutation preserves hidden");
        check(false, root.contains(6), "nested mutation removes allowed");
        check(true, nested.removeAll(List.of(8, 3)), "nested removeAll");
        check(true, root.contains(3), "removeAll hidden invariant");

        TreeMap<Integer, Integer> base = new TreeMap<>();
        base.put(0, 0);
        base.put(2, -2);
        base.put(4, 4);
        base.put(6, null);
        base.put(8, 8);
        NavigableMap<Integer, Integer> map = M3MutableFilteredViews.filterEntries(base, MAP_FILTER);
        TreeMap<Integer, Integer> incoming = new TreeMap<>();
        incoming.put(10, 10);
        incoming.put(12, -12);
        fails(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> map.putAll(incoming), "map bulk rejects hidden value");
        check(false, base.containsKey(10), "map atomic predicate preflight");
        check(true, map.entrySet().removeIf(entry -> entry.getKey() >= 6), "entrySet removeIf");
        check(false, base.containsKey(6), "removed visible null-valued entry");
        check(false, base.containsKey(8), "removed visible positive entry");
        check(true, base.containsKey(2), "kept hidden negative value");
        check(List.of(0, 4), new ArrayList<>(map.navigableKeySet()), "remaining visible keys");
        fails(UnsupportedOperationException.class, () -> map.navigableKeySet().add(10),
                "JDK keySet addition always unsupported");
        fails(UnsupportedOperationException.class, () -> map.navigableKeySet().add(3),
                "JDK keySet addition unsupported even when hidden");
        fails(UnsupportedOperationException.class,
                () -> map.navigableKeySet().subSet(0, true, 6, false).addAll(List.of(0, 4)),
                "JDK keySet range addition unsupported");
        fails(UnsupportedOperationException.class,
                () -> map.descendingKeySet().add(10),
                "descending keySet addition unsupported");
        Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> selected = map.entrySet().stream()
                .filter(entry -> entry.getKey() == 4).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        base.put(4, -44);
        fails(IllegalStateException.class, () -> selected.setValue(44), "entry hidden by backing mutation");
        check(-44, base.get(4), "entry failure does not mutate hidden mapping");
        map.put(4, 40);
        check(40, base.get(4), "admitted put makes hidden entry visible");
        check(40, map.get(4), "visible restored through view");
        NavigableMap<Integer, Integer> tail = map.tailMap(4, true).descendingMap();
        check(List.of(4), new ArrayList<>(tail.navigableKeySet()), "nested map descending keys");
        tail.put(10, 10);
        check(true, base.containsKey(10), "nested map put backed");
        check(10, tail.pollFirstEntry().getKey(), "poll first descending map");
        check(false, base.containsKey(10), "poll first mutates backing");
        check(4, tail.pollLastEntry().getKey(), "poll last descending map");
        check(false, base.containsKey(4), "poll last mutates backing");
        check(null, tail.pollFirstEntry(), "empty filtered poll");
    }

    private static void nullContracts() {
        NavigableSet<Integer> set = new TreeSet<>(Comparator.nullsFirst(Integer::compare));
        set.add(null); set.add(1); set.add(2);
        NavigableSet<Integer> view = M3MutableFilteredViews.filter(set, x -> x == null || x % 2 == 0);
        check(true, view.contains(null), "nullable set contains");
        check(null, view.first(), "nullable set first");
        Iterator<Integer> cursor = view.iterator();
        check(null, cursor.next(), "nullable set iterator value");
        cursor.remove();
        check(false, set.contains(null), "nullable set iterator remove");

        NavigableMap<Integer, Integer> map = new TreeMap<>(Comparator.nullsFirst(Integer::compare));
        map.put(null, 5); map.put(2, null); map.put(3, 3);
        NavigableMap<Integer, Integer> filtered = M3MutableFilteredViews.filterEntries(map,
                (k, v) -> k == null || (k % 2 == 0 && v == null));
        check(true, filtered.containsKey(null), "nullable map key");
        check(5, filtered.firstEntry().getValue(), "nullable map first entry");
        Iterator<Map.Entry<Integer, Integer>> it = filtered.entrySet().iterator();
        check(null, it.next().getKey(), "nullable map iterator null key");
        check(2, it.next().getKey(), "nullable map successor after null");
        check(true, filtered.navigableKeySet().contains(null), "nullable keyset contains null");
        filtered.navigableKeySet().remove(null);
        check(false, map.containsKey(null), "nullable keyset removal");
    }
}
